subject: IntegrateAI 4-week trial — ops checklist, ownership & weekly pulse
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@integrate.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@integrate.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: IntegrateAI POC — short recap + proposed ops checklist

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Quick recap and a lightweight ops checklist so we can start the 4-week trial without surprises. Highlights from the call:

- Goal: Measure inference latency and cost at 100k tokens/day with your anonymized sample set, validate end-to-end integration with your inference pipeline, and confirm parity on generation quality for 3 core prompts.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  1) P50 latency < 150ms and P95 < 400ms at target throughput;
  2) Per-token inference cost delta within 20% of your baseline;
  3) No functional regressions on the 3 named prompts (sample prompts attached in Drive).
- Timeline: kickoff next Monday (23 Nov) — 4 weeks, two intermediate check-ins (end of week 1 & week 3), final review week 4.
- Ownership: Redwood will run the hosted trial infra and give an ops contact; IntegrateAI to provide sample dataset, test keys, and a primary engineering contact.

Attached: IntegrateAI-POC-Ops-Checklist.xlsx (ops tasks + owner column). I also attached a draft POC SLA for your review.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or list changes by EOD Thursday 19 Nov.
2) Share a sanitized sample of ~2k prompts + expected outputs by 20 Nov.
3) I'll send calendar invites for kickoff + weekly standups after we confirm.

If you want a shorter or longer trial we can adjust, but it's easiest to start with a focused 4-week window.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: IntegrateAI-POC-Ops-Checklist.xlsx (Excel, 3 sheets); POC-SLA-draft.docx (Word)

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@integrate.ai>

Thanks Rachel — this is helpful. Quick confirmations and a couple tweaks: 

- We agree with the three success criteria; request to relax P95 to 450ms at peak since some of our longer prompts spike.
- We'll provide the 2k sanitized prompts by Friday 20 Nov — Priya will share an S3 link.
- IntegrateAI primary contact: Sam Patel (me) for product, and Priya for data.

One ask: can Redwood provide a small sample run (500 prompts) before kickoff so we can sanity-check tokenization/formatting? If yes, we can push the kickoff to Mon 23 but still keep the 4-week window.

I attached the signed NDA to this reply.
